src: const k = sketch('top'); k.circle(40); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('side'); sk.polygon([[9,11.4],[12.4,11.4],[11,19.3],[9,19.3]]); groove(sk, t, 360);

brep.refused: groove groove1: the ring is spun about the normal of its sketch, which crosses the axis of pull1's round wall -- sketch the ring on a plane square to that axis (the top plane for an upright post) -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a ring with a slanted or curved side (a triangle, a circle, a rounded corner) is not built, because in the measurements the engine cut such rings wrongly or took minutes and the two cannot be told apart in advance; give the ring straight sides that are parallel and square to its axis.
